model2.reason: outside the validated zone: Прогноз росту підтверджено лише для Канади (перевірений регіон); для цієї точки його немає.

image.corners_order: top-left, top-right, bottom-right, bottom-left (Mapbox image source / Leaflet corners)
image.note: Sentinel-2 true colour, July-August 2026, brightness stretched (98th percentile, gamma 0.8). The raster is rotated relative to north; place it by corners_lonlat.

reliability.model1: ranking score, not a calibrated probability; a summary over the whole fire is more reliable than a single cell. Pixels whose signals fall outside the model's training range (bare or very dark ground) are excluded; excluded_share says how much, and the numbers are slightly optimistic by about that share
reliability.model2: growth curve validated for Canada, fire age 8-36 years; the 80% interval covered 82% of fires (nominal 80%). On 9 fires outside the training regions it overestimated recovery by ~12 points on average
